source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The drag test checks URI and URL flavors, the file promise provider, exported message content and the destination folder notification. It waits for message-saved before reading a file and msgsMoveCopyCompleted before checking moved message IDs. Current coverage also checks that a second file export leaves the first file intact and creates a numbered file. This distinguishes correct drag metadata from a completed move or export. The filename regular expression is not adopted as a syntax rule; escaping and platform filename details were not independently validated.
title: Test a message drag through transfer flavors and its completed effect
